More than a guild name

A community to
journey with.

We’re here to enjoy World of Warcraft together—and to represent Christ in the way we do it. From a quiet evening of questing to a dungeon run that goes sideways, friendship and fellowship are at the heart of CotC.

You don’t have to be a Christian to join. You’re welcome to play, ask questions, and build friendships while respecting the Christian identity and standards of our community.

Read our mission & values →
01

Faith lived openly

Talk about Scripture, share a prayer request, and encourage one another. Faith is part of who we are.

02

A place for families

PG conversations, kindness, and respect. An atmosphere where families can comfortably play together.

03

People before pixels

Welcome someone new. Lend a hand. Invite another player along. The best loot is the friendships we keep.

Life in Carriers of the Cross

The journey is better
with good company.

Some of us level quickly. Others take the scenic route. We make room for shared adventures, conversations about faith, prayer, and simply enjoying each other’s company.

Discord keeps us connected beyond the game, with space to organize groups, share encouragement, and get to know the people behind the characters.
